roles.description: Subset of: orchestrator, triage, static, dynamic, decoy-audit, critic, reporter. Defaults to the configured default roles.

roleDeps.description: Role dependencies, format "role:dep1,dep2;role2:dep" — e.g. "critic:static,dynamic". A role starts only after its prerequisites are done.

caseDir.description: Ticket workspace directory; defaults to the active case or session cwd.

budgetMinutes.description: Per-worker wall-time budget in minutes (1-60); workers report blocked when exhausted.

maxToolCalls.description: Advisory tool-call budget for workers; recorded on the ticket.
